ValidationRule.description: Prevent other user to updates notes.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Commercial_Opportunity', ISCHANGED(My_Notes__c), $User.Id <> Owner.Id )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only owner is allowed to update the notes.
